design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled; 71 patients in China with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis; 12 weeks
efficacy_measure: Forced vital capacity (secondary endpoint; primary endpoint was safety and tolerability)
result: Adverse events similar across arms (72-83% on rentosertib, 71% on placebo); FVC +98.4 mL at 60 mg once daily versus -20.3 mL on placebo
